description: Summarize the Form 4 filings of one company (ticker or name) or one insider over a period, from 2020 to today: how many filings, lines and insiders; open-market purchases and sales (count, shares, USD value, and how much of it was under a Rule 10b5-1 plan); every transaction type; the most active insiders; and the largest filings with their source_url. Default period: the last 365 days.

days.description: Look back this many days from today. Default 365. Leave out when you give from.

insider.description: Part of the reporting person's name as filed, e.g. Huang. SEC filings usually write the last name first (HUANG JEN HSUN).

issuer.description: Part of the issuer's company name, e.g. Nvidia. Use ticker when you know it.

ticker.description: The issuer's exchange ticker, e.g. NVDA (case does not matter). Matched on the company's SEC identifier (CIK), so filings made under an earlier ticker are included (META also finds the FB years).

name: summarize_issuer_insiders
title: Summarize insider activity for one company or one insider (SEC Form 4)
